Definition: to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold
BiblicalUsage: 1) to diminish, restrain, withdraw, abate, keep back, do away, take from, clip; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to diminish; 1a2) to restrain; 1a3) to withdraw; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be withdrawn; 1b2) to be restrained; 1c) (Piel) to withdraw, draw up
